Usman Khawaja’s memoir has brought Australia’s infamous Sandpapergate scandal back into the spotlight, eight years after the 2018 ball-tampering controversy rocked international cricket. What happened during the Cape Town Test? Why were Steve Smith, David Warner and Cameron Bancroft suspended? And what new details has Khawaja revealed about the controversy?
Watch this video for a breakdown of the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal, Khawaja’s revelations and its lasting impact on Australian cricket.
Thank you for watching our video!
